verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a multimedia transcoding CLI and library, not an AI agent or assistant that orchestrates tool calls, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows FFmpeg ships any MCP or agent tool-use capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
